name: TorrentKitty
note: Answers Cloudflare's addresses again and refuses the relay's server with 403 (2026-09-25; the other way round on 2026-09-05), so it is asked directly and is on by default. Its size column is often the .torrent file's own size rather than the content's (223.04 kb for a 3 GB Ubuntu ISO, seen 2026-09-25), so size is not read: no size beats a wrong one, and a copy of the same torrent from another index fills it in. A nonsense query returns nothing, so its rows are real.
